name: Incentive Scheme in Civil Service (Chhattisgarh)
benefit:
- ₹20,000/- lump sum on passing the Preliminary Examination.
- ₹30,000/- lump sum on passing the Mains Examination.
- ₹50,000/- lump sum on selection in Union/Chhattisgarh Public Service Commission.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Chhattisgarh.
1. The applicant should have a disability of 40% or above.
1. The applicant should have passed the Union or Chhattisgarh Public Service Commission Competitive Examination.
